extDesc.message: Read every QR code on a page, including images and canvas. Decodes on your device and never opens a link on its own.
extDesc.description: Extension description. Single purpose, CWS listing summary, must stay under 132 chars.

actionTitle.message: Read QR codes on this page

popupSelectArea.description: Secondary button, starts the drag-to-select region reader.

popupScanning.description: Status while a scan is running.

popupNoneFound.message: No QR code found on this page
popupNoneFound.description: Empty state after a scan that found nothing.

popupNoneHint.message: Try Select an area and drag a box around the code.
popupNoneHint.description: Hint shown under the empty state.

popupFoundOne.description: Result header when exactly one code was decoded.

popupFoundMany.description: Result header for more than one code. $1 = count.

popupCopy.description: Copies a decoded value to the clipboard.

popupOpen.description: Opens a decoded URL. Requires an explicit click, never automatic.

popupOpenWarn.message: Check the address before you open it.

popupSourceImage.description: Label for a code found in an img element.

popupSourceCanvas.description: Label for a code found in a canvas element.

popupSourceBackground.description: Label for a code found in a CSS background image.

popupSourceSelection.description: Label for a code found in a user-selected area.

popupRestricted.description: Shown on chrome:// and Web Store pages where extensions cannot run.

popupRestrictedHint.message: Chrome blocks extensions on its own pages. Open a normal web page and try again.

selectHint.message: Drag a box around the code. Press Escape to cancel.

selectTooSmall.message: That area is too small to read
selectTooSmall.description: Shown when the dragged box is under the minimum size.

optionsHistory.message: Keep a local history of what I scan

optionsHistoryHint.message: Stored on this device only. Clear it any time.

optionsClear.description: Button that empties the local history.

optionsEmpty.description: Empty state for the history list.

optionsPrivacyTitle.message: What this reads and where it goes
optionsPrivacyTitle.description: Privacy section heading on the options page.

optionsPrivacyBody.message: Decoding happens on your device. Nothing you scan is sent anywhere, and the extension has no server.
